drafts.title: Hold
drafts.pitch: Cursor asks Null to check the weather, Null is on hold so long the conversation fills and ends, and the answer arrives to an empty room.
drafts.reason: Funny 7, clear 8, in-world 9, fresh 7. Very in-world and the empty-room ending is good, but the answer-arrives-too-late beat is close to Overdue's and the quiet last line is softer than recent closers.

drafts.title: Leftovers
drafts.pitch: In a kitchen the day after a big dinner, Cursor's new ideas for leftovers are all the same food, and the user says it's day four.
drafts.reason: Funny 4, clear 8, in-world 2, fresh 4. Outside the context room with no world mechanic, and the repetition gag is a generic leftovers joke that echoes Regenerate and Ok.
